name: Pyapun
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

sources.citation: Blench, Roger & Michael Bulkaam. 2019. Tal dictionary, December 2019 (unpublished PDF, rogerblench.info A3/Talic/Tal/).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Closest sister language (Talic); dictionary front matter usually has a phonology/tone-marking section that would be the nearest proxy for Piapung-Koenoem prosody (identity differs: tall1248).

sources.citation: Decker, Ken, Adedamola Aregbesola, Christina Riepe, Fittokka Gobak, John Sacson & Samuel Eju. 2021. A Sociolinguistic Profile of the Piapung (Pyapun) [pcw] Language of Plateau State, Nigeria. Journal of Language Survey Reports 2021-007. Dallas: SIL International. 56 pp. (SIL entry 88034; downloaded from the Internet Archive 20241219032417 of the sil.org reapdata PDF)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Sec. 6.3 (pp.12-13) gives 'initial, tentative observations on the phonology of Piapung.. there was no in-depth analysis of tones or other phonological features, nor has there been an effort to determine the phonemic status of phones' -- consonant and vowel inventories only; Appendix E (p.37): 'The transcriptions are preliminary since there was no in-depth analysis of tones or other phonological or phonetic features.' The words stress/accent occur nowhere in the report; 348-item wordlists (Moedom, Moewa dialects + Koenoem) are untoned phonetic transcriptions.
